card.title: Ask Around the Missing Detail
card.instruction: Find one hidden fact by asking about everything surrounding it and never naming it directly.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did the jeweller put that little box in a gift bag?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Are you asking whether I bought you a ring?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I am asking whether I should keep Saturday free.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And should I have my nails done before then, or would that spoil whatever we are not discussing?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 asks packaging, A3 asks timing and A5 asks nail preparation, circling B2 named ring purchase without naming it A's self.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 names ring; A3 sidesteps to Saturday; B4 gives evening; A5 asks preparation relevant to that occasion.

relationship.evidence: B2 recognizes the indirect inquiry and B4 cooperates selectively while preserving surprise.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 evening clue to probe whether presentation of hands matters.

specificity.evidence: A1 jeweller box and B2 ring establish the suspected surprise without needing a stated proposal.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 whatever we are not discussing acknowledges shared evasion while asking a useful surrounding detail.
